evidence.quote: Master's thesis in Management and Economics of Innovation

Evaluating GenAI in software development involves both quantitative metrics like time savings and productivity, and qualitative measures such as user satisfaction and perceived value, to fully assess its impact and utility.
The semi-structured interviews were held with people from all the different departments of the case company but with slightly more focus on the Engineering department. This resulted in 27 interviews
Other aspects potentially interesting to evaluate according to software developers were related to the coding process such as the number of bugs introduced by these tools.
The survey contains several questions that are directly linked to DevEx and SPACE.
This results in the following questions within the satisfaction and well-being dimension from SPACE "When using GenAI tools I feel more creative"
and cognitive load within DevEx "I believe GenAI can provide me with insights and perspectives I may not have thought of myself"
To enable quantitative analysis, Likert scales have been used for several questions.
During interviews it was described that quantitative metrics of interest were time savings, productivity improvements, and quality of software outputs.
